# Floor files that Rust code or Rust tests read. A pull request that changes one of them runs the
# Rust jobs even when it touches nothing else outside floor/.
#
# One path per line, or a directory as `dir/*`. `cargo xtask floor-reads` fails when Rust source
# under crates/, bins/ or xtask/ points into floor/ at a path this list does not cover.

floor/dist/*
floor/index.html
floor/src/renderer/looks.json
floor/src/renderer/ticket/ticket.ts
floor/src/renderer/ticket/words.ts
floor/src/session.ts
floor/tests/fixtures/signed-request-v1.json
floor/tests/fixtures/static-contract.json
floor/tests/helpers/project-word.mjs
floor/tests/helpers/terminal-commands.mjs
